q: By the end of 2030, the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) is completed and the Future Combined Forces Command is launched under a South Korean commander
basis: South Korea has floated 2027–2028 and the USFK commander the first quarter of 2029, but the transfer has been postponed twice before. The U.S. National Defense Authorization Act barred spending on completing the transfer in a way that departs from the plan agreed by Seoul and Washington (fiscal 2026), and the Senate Armed Services Committee's bill would make completion of the transfer itself wait for the secretary of defense's certification and a 60-day waiting period.
rs: A joint announcement by the South Korean and U.S. defense ministries
